01 / Functional precedents

A. LIGHT & SHADOW

Observed:

and shadow.

Design reading:

shape an ambient response.

B. A MEASURE OF FEELING

Observed:

A physical gesture becomes a

visible measure of personal

significance.

Design reading:

Measure the duration of an

embrace, turning time spent

into a tangible expression of

care.

C. TIME & RITUAL

Observed:

Time becomes a visible,

tangible arrangement.

Design reading:

Recall a familiar rhythm,

rather than simulate a person.

Reference images from the author’s collection; interpretations are design readings.
